classification.difficultyReason: Add outside side lengths, using equal-length marks and multiplication for repeated lengths; distinguish internal measurements from perimeter.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of these shapes. Remember to use multiplication for repeated addition.

spec.description: Upright square, with single equality ticks on all four sides and 7 m beside the right side.
spec.mathematics: Four equal outside sides, each 7 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Side length is permanently visible; perimeter is answer-only.

spec.description: Oblique triangle with left, upper-right and lower-right vertices. The lower-left side is 9 mm; the other two sides share single ticks, and the right side is 16 mm.
spec.mathematics: Outside side lengths are 16 mm, 16 mm and 9 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source measurements and equality ticks are visible.

spec.description: Left-pointing oblique triangle with one tick on every side and 1.3 cm beside the right side.
spec.mathematics: Three equal outside sides, each 1.3 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: The source length remains visible; the perimeter is hidden from the prompt.

spec.description: Two-peak polygon with a taller left peak, shorter right peak and valley ledge. Triple ticks pair the 12 m slopes; double ticks pair the 6 m slopes; single ticks identify three short horizontal ledges and two outer vertical ends as 2 m each. Bottom side is 22 m.
spec.mathematics: Ten boundary segments: two of 12 m, two of 6 m, five of 2 m and one of 22 m. Source silhouette is schematic.
spec.answerVisibility: All source givens and three equality families remain visible; calculated perimeter is answer-only.

spec.description: Irregularly oriented pentagon with single ticks on every side and 2.1 m beside its upper-right slope.
spec.mathematics: Five equal outside sides, each 2.1 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied length and equality marks are printed in the question.

spec.description: Unshaded rectilinear cross with all twelve outside segments individually marked by matching single ticks. Rightmost vertical segment is labelled 8 cm.
spec.mathematics: Twelve equal boundary segments of 8 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: All twelve marks and the source length remain visible; no perimeter is supplied in the prompt.

spec.description: Right-leaning parallelogram, with 50 cm on both horizontal sides and 35 cm on both sloping sides. Internal vertical double-headed arrow between horizontal sides is labelled 30 cm.
spec.mathematics: Perimeter uses two 50 cm sides and two 35 cm sides. The redundant internal 30 cm measurement is retained for part i.
spec.answerVisibility: All five source measurements remain visible; calculated perimeter is answer-only.

spec.description: Oblique equal-sided quadrilateral with four matching single ticks and 15 cm on its lower-right outside side. A double-headed internal diagonal runs from the lower-left to upper-right vertex and is labelled 5 cm.
spec.mathematics: Four outside sides of 15 cm. Source schematic proportions are retained; the internal 5 cm diagonal is excluded from perimeter and retained for part i.
spec.answerVisibility: Both source lengths and all equality marks remain visible; calculated perimeter is answer-only.

inlines.text: part of the perimeter in parts

answer.short: Those lengths are not on the outside of the shape.
answer.worked: The 30 cm height and 5 cm diagonal are inside the shapes. Perimeter is the distance around the outside boundary, so these lengths are not included.
